sourceConclusions: The shared UoW probe preserves the old L algorithm; the complete diff changes only M marker, control schema, database/role/port/private path and trace operation.
Cargo adds m_shared_uow_probe and m_number_probe without changing the old L example, product routes, dependencies or lock.

The new number probe calls the actual Rust BusinessNumberService over all nine compiled scopes, bounded stdin and years4000..8998 plus the next synthetic year; before-present scope/year rows reject execution.

Borrowed-connection rollback is labelled separately from standalone allocation. Eight concurrent allocations, UTC boundary and the independent commit surviving caller rollback are explicit finite observations to be run.
Native SDK wiring selects the one actual BusinessNumberService provider and only adds m.internal-numbers to the explicit operation whitelist; its real next(scope,at,em) signature matches the call.
The separate number lease fixes nine scopes/two years, journals before-absence, records18 complete expected rows with xmin, and permits only exact row+xmin deletion after writer drain.
The physical primary key remains id. The lease uses the(scope,period)unique key and never adopts query-returned UUIDs into fixture ownership.
The lease requires two fresh validated connections with distinct PIDs and zero rows after acknowledged COMMIT; unknown changes/commit errors retain recovery state.

Root's external owner-only marker and complete low-privilege metadata admission must precede probes. The app probe checks the input marker/endpoint/role and cannot read the owner-only marker row itself.

Use only the frozen current managed environment, before-absent synthetic scopes/years and a source/run-bound number lease. No old private files, ambient database overrides or current real-year allocation.

Preserve complete Native and Rust number strings for actual comparison, including prefix/year; suffix checks are not a new all-format proof. Native independent-EM and Rust borrowed-connection semantics remain separately labelled.
Source rows, UoW transaction traces, actual INSERT/COMMIT and independent visibility still need Root's bounded execution and observer certification; source review grants no DTO/query-ID ownership.

After all writers drain, delete only the exact number-lease rows and preserve recovery state on discrepancy. restoreAfterDrain is a single-use source operation; any later no-op cleanup claim needs an actual empty-key verification.
Do not run these probes until the shared runtime/observer/caller inputs are also frozen. Raw stdout/stderr and row facts stay in the new private evidence path.
